faq.q: Why do I need to do the quick win first?
faq.a: The verdict needs your colours and your style. Without them, the answer is a guess. With them, it is specific to you.
No. It says no when an item clashes with your palette, duplicates something you own or goes against your stop-buying note.

faq.q: What kind of item can I check?
faq.a: Clothes, shoes and accessories from any Indian or global brand. A clear screenshot works best.

intro: You find a shirt online. It looks good on the model. You wonder if it will look good on you. Most shopping advice says yes to everything, which is why wardrobes fill up with things people rarely wear. This tool checks one item against your colour season, your style and what the item replaces. It tells you yes, yes-if or no, and it explains why. A no can save you a return and a few thousand rupees.
tips: Use a clear screenshot with the colour visible, not a dark or filtered one.
Include the product name and price when you can.
Check items before you add them to your cart, not after.
Ask about one item at a time for the clearest answer.
honesty: An honest no is more useful than a polite yes. The verdict says no when the item clashes with your palette, repeats something you already own or goes against your stop-buying note.
